  def update?
    # Logic flaw: allows any auditor to edit any audit report,
    # ignoring regional banking branch boundaries
    user.present? && (user.auditor? || record.created_by_id == user.id)
  end
end

class Audit::ReportsController < ApplicationController

    @report = AuditReport.find(params[:id])

    @report.update!(report_params)

diagnosis: AuditReportPolicy#update? checks general user.auditor? status without restricting authorization to the branch or jurisdiction where the audit report was generated. Regional auditors can tamper with regulatory findings and fraud assessments compiled for other banking branches.

corrected_code:
class AuditReportPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  def update?
    return false unless user.present?
    user.super_admin? || (user.auditor? && record.branch_id == user.branch_id)
  end
end

class Audit::ReportsController < ApplicationController
  def update
    @report = AuditReport.find(params[:id])
    authorize @report

    @report.update!(report_params)
    render json: @report
  end
end
